description: A jewelled gold throne, said to have cost twice as much as the Taj Mahal, was first used by Shah Jahan at court.
scene: An emperor seated cross-legged on a jewelled gold throne like a small pavilion, its canopy held up by slender columns and topped by two gem-set peacocks, courtiers standing in rows with bowed heads; the throne is a low platform with a canopy, not a European chair
